records.project_scope: New permanent steel-frame NavSTAR hangar with a 25,172 sq ft footprint (approximately 2,339 m²), supporting simultaneous one-in/one-out fixed-wing carrier aircraft compatibility testing. Includes a climate-controlled maintenance/testing bay, workshop, two logistics warehouses, payload storage, security office, personnel support areas, and ICD 705-compliant secure rooms. Structure comprises a steel superstructure, built-up roofing assembly, and reinforced-concrete spread footings. Associated works include a fixed-wing taxiway connecting to the existing catapult system, rotary-wing parking apron, hangar apron, vehicle parking, access roads, utility connections, stormwater facilities, potentially 10,000 cubic yards of earthworks, a 750 kW standby generator, approximately 650 linear feet of 8-foot security fencing, and two vehicle slide gates. Structural spans and building height are not stated.
records.services: Integrated design-build services covering architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, energy, utility, stormwater, security, and cybersecurity design and construction. Includes site preparation, foundations, steel erection, paving, utility interfaces and cutovers, system commissioning, cybersecurity testing, operational validation, Operations and Maintenance Support Information manuals, and Post Construction Award Services. No HOAI service phases are specified.
records.relevance_explanation:
- Aircraft hangars are a priority project type for sbp because of their potentially long-span roof structures; actual spans are not disclosed.
